title: Pressing Tab in enum dropdown doesn't work properly
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.stable.arch_linux [5b4e0cb0f]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 27 Jun 2026 16:15:10 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 610.43.02) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.28 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When searching for an enum value and pressing Tab to select the first result, it is not selected.
I found out it happens when the pointers is in the dropdown box and is hovering on an item. If the pointer is outside the box, then pressing Tab selects the first result.

This is annoying, because searching should be faster, so pressing Tab should select the first result regardless of where the pointer is.

Video, if it helps:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5ac52189-c1d8-4758-b92f-79bfdd74d186

### Steps to reproduce

1. Export an enum.
2. Search for a key with the pointer inside the dropdown.
3. Press Tab and watch it select the first result after a few presses.
4. Search again with the pointer outside the dropdown.
5. Press Tab and watch it select the first result after a single press.

N/A
